subject: general
question: What price should Kunal mark on a pair of pants which costs him ₹3,300, so as to gain 33% after allowing a successive discount of 25% and 30%?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net **Successive Discount** = a + b − (a × b) ÷ 100 = 25 + 30 − (25 × 30) ÷ 100 = 55 − 7.5 = **47.5%**.

Using the ratio formula: **MP ÷ CP = (100 + Gain%) ÷ (100 − Discount%)**.

MP ÷ 3300 = (100 + 33) ÷ (100 − 47.5) = 133 ÷ 52.5.

MP = (133 × 3300) ÷ 52.5 = **₹8,360**.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹8,360.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Cost Price (CP) = **₹3,300**, Gain% = **33%**, Successive Discounts = **25%** and **30%**.

**Formulas:** SP = CP × (100 + Gain%) ÷ 100 | MP = SP × 100 ÷ (100 − D₁%) × 100 ÷ (100 − D₂%)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6f5c51c4f711a479de7090d941a401445814291831946e0170df9385f5ca58f2.png] 

⇒ Step 1: Selling Price (SP) = 3300 × (133 ÷ 100) = 33 × 133 = **₹4,389**.

⇒ Step 2: Let **Marked Price** be MP.

⇒ Step 3: MP × (75 ÷ 100) × (70 ÷ 100) = 4389.

⇒ Step 4: MP × (3 ÷ 4) × (7 ÷ 10) = 4389.

⇒ Step 5: MP = (4389 × 40) ÷ 21 = 209 × 40 = **₹8,360**.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹8,360.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relation between CP and MP

The relationship between Cost Price and Marked Price is given by CP ÷ MP = (100 − D%) ÷ (100 + P%).

Successive Discounts

When two discounts d₁ and d₂ are given, the effective discount is single discount = (d₁ + d₂ − d₁d₂/100)%.
